Replying to @user4035138500626 Thinking about leaving Etsy because of its new AI policy? You might want to read the terms and conditions of Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Faire Wholesale and Amazon while you’re at it. 👀 There’s a whole lot of speculation and conspiracy theories going around about what Etsy might do with your content. Could a corporation violate its own legal agreements? Sure. But the legal and financial risks that come with that are pretty damn significant. Here’s the thing. AI isn’t going anywhere and running from one platform to another isn’t going to solve that. Nobody is forcing you to sell on Etsy. Read the documentation, understand what you’re agreeing to and make a business decision. Over here we operate on facts, not fear. #EtsySeller #EtsyShopOwner #SellingOnEtsy #EtsyBusiness #EtsyAIPolicy
